## Question

State the bounded legal design question.

## Current legal state

Identify the relevant accepted provisions, or state that none exist.

## Objective and constraints

What must a proposal try to achieve, and which constraints must it preserve?

## Required analysis

List the dependencies, interests, cases or objections a useful proposal must address.

## Open alternatives

Identify known alternatives without treating one as accepted in advance.

## Sources and uncertainty

Link checked material and identify unknowns.

## Authorship disclosure

State any material AI involvement and the human role.
